verdict.rationale: Bolt lets developers edit code directly in code view and connect to source control (GitHub), including creating a new repo from a Bolt project or pushing to an existing one, which enables exporting/syncing the full codebase outside the platform; it also runs on Node.js/npm-based projects (Vite, Next.js, etc.) that are standard runnable outside Bolt. missing for 10: no explicit first-party 'download zip' or CLI export documented, and no independent hands-on confirmation that exported repos run cleanly outside Bolt without platform-specific dependencies (e.g., Supabase lock-in noted by community).
